name: Youtarr
description: Youtarr is a self-hosted YouTube downloader that automatically downloads videos from your favorite channels or specific URLs. With optional Plex integration, it can refresh your media library for a seamless, ad-free viewing experience. By default the container runs as root. To run as a non-root user (e.g. nobody:users so Plex/Jellyfin can manage the downloaded files), see the Unraid-specific instructions at https://github.com/DialmasterOrg/Youtarr/blob/main/docs/platforms/Unraid.md

paths.name: YouTube Output Directory
paths.description: Path to store downloaded YouTube videos

variables.name: YouTube Output Directory Host
variables.description: Host path to your downloaded YouTube videos. Should match the host side of 'YouTube Output Directory' above. Used only to display the path inside the Youtarr web UI.

variables.name: Database - Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP of your MariaDB server. On Unraid, use your server's LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.100). Do NOT use 'localhost' or '127.0.0.1' - those resolve to this container, not your Unraid host.

variables.name: Database - Port
variables.description: Port of your MariaDB server. Standard MariaDB is 3306.

variables.name: Database - Name
variables.description: Name of the database Youtarr should use. Must already exist on your MariaDB server.

variables.name: Database - User
variables.description: MariaDB username with read/write access to the database above.

variables.name: Database - Password
variables.description: Password for the MariaDB user above.

variables.name: Auth - Enabled
variables.description: Enable the built-in login for Youtarr's web UI. Leave 'true' unless Youtarr is only reachable over LAN/VPN or is behind an authenticating reverse proxy - setting 'false' exposes the full UI with no password.

variables.name: Auth - Username
variables.description: Strongly recommended on Unraid: set this and Auth - Password together to seed initial login credentials. Without them, Youtarr's first-run setup wizard only accepts connections from 'localhost' on the Unraid host, which is awkward for headless installs. Must be 3-32 characters; if either this or Auth - Password fails validation, both are ignored.

variables.name: Auth - Password
variables.description: Initial admin password (8-64 characters). Must be set together with Auth - Username or both are ignored. You can change this later from within the Youtarr UI.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity. Options: info (default), warn, debug.
